summary: Iter54 e2e — backend 10/10 pass: /api/admin/llm/spend (4 windows, superadmin-gated, schema + seeded data), unique index on llm_deep_usage(account_id, surface, day_utc) confirmed, race-safe deep quota verified at-cap (5 parallel, 0 overage, count stays at 10) and under-cap (count=8, 5 parallel → exactly 2 allowed, count==10, no 11+ overage), Postmark inbound EICAR rejected returns 200 ok:false error:virus_scan + audit_log row written. Frontend: 4 full-page admin screenshots captured (llm-spend/health/sandbox-kpi/signal-kpi) — all testids present (dashboard/tiles/by-surface/by-day/by-account); seeded llm_deep_usage data populates dashboard. Non-superadmin (bramuel) on /admin/llm-spend redirects to /app with 'Superadmin only.' toast (403 from API also visible in console). Enterprise page 'Update my note →' (testid enterprise-update-note-btn) renders on thanks state; click returns to form. No regressions.

issues: Layout looks clean — tiles/by-surface/by-day sparkline/top accounts table all render. Suggestion: surface mix bars all show same width because pctOfTotal is computed per-row from total calls — bars are proportional but ordering by calls makes the top one usually 100%; consider relative (max in window) to read more dynamic. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: llm_tier_quota.check_and_consume now race-safe via two-pass (find_one_and_update with {count:{$lt:limit}} → fall-through insert with unique index catching duplicates). Verified zero overage with 5 parallel calls at and under cap. Strong improvement over iter53.

admin_llm_spend.py — uses Depends(_require_superadmin) which calls Depends(get_current_account); good. Window cap is 365d, returns up to 20k rows in a single find — fine today (one-row-per-user-per-surface-per-day) but if the user base 100x's, paginate or pre-aggregate.

inbound_email.write_audit on virus_scan + bad_attachment paths confirmed firing; uses message_id as resource_id which is correct for traceability. If MessageID is missing the literal string '(no-id)' is used as resource_id — multiple no-id rejections will collide on resource_id; consider a fallback uuid.

LLMSpend.jsx — by-surface bar uses pctOfTotal which produces a 100% bar for the top surface always (since the max IS that surface). The bar therefore visually communicates dominance but loses ratio information for surfaces beyond #1 vs each other. Cosmetic.
LLMSpend has no empty-state for total_calls=0 except per-section ('No deep-tier calls in this window.'), which is fine; tiles still show 0 cleanly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 admin screenshots captured, redirects & enterprise update-note verified
